DashboardProviderSteps.content: Welcome to the dashboard! Let us guide you through the main features.
This section provides guides on how to create a profile that attracts customers, manage service inquiries, and set your prices.
Here you can view and respond to pending inquiries from customers and manage customer interactions.
This section displays your notifications and keeps you updated on progress in your inquiries.
Here you can see and manage all your planned appointments. You can import your appointments from your Google Calendar or export appointments to ICS.

This section is the most important one for the start. Here you can manage your service profile, including adding details like experience and expertise. Please add a service range and the services you want to offer, else receiver can't find you.
